_about: Public-domain George Horne (1730-1792), Bishop of Norwich and President of Magdalen, for the Word Hoard: his Works (London: J. Johnson, 1809, six volumes, with memoirs by William Jones of Nayland: the Commentary on the Psalms, discourses and tracts), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
